reason: The motor needs a stable place on the base, and this is the only available action.
expectation: I expect the motor to be mounted on the wave-machine base, ready for its drive parts.

effect: The motor is mounted, so the eccentric driver is the next available part to add.
reaction: A straightforward setup step; nothing notable yet.
reason: The driver seems likely to turn the motor’s rotation into movement for the cord, and it is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the eccentric driver to be fitted to the frame, though it may still need a belt to connect it to the motor.

effect: The off-centre swivel peg will disturb one end of the cord as it circles; the belt should connect the motor to the driver.
reaction: The explanation makes the intended wiggle mechanism clearer.
reason: Fit the belt to connect the drive; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the belt to link the motor and eccentric driver, though the cord and power will still need adding.

effect: The belt drive is in place, so the cord can now be added.
reaction: A straightforward connection step; nothing notable.
reason: The cord is needed to show the wiggle, and this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the cord to be attached to the driver and frame, though it may still need tensioning.

effect: The cord is fitted but loose, so it needs tensioning.
reaction: The loose-cord result makes the spring’s purpose clear.
reason: Add the spring to tension the cord; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the spring to hold the cord taut while allowing it to move.

effect: The cord is tensioned, leaving the drive guard as the next offered fitting.
reaction: A straightforward preparation step; nothing notable.
reason: Fit the guard over the moving drive; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the clear guard to cover the belt and drive while leaving them visible.

effect: The guard protects fingers while keeping the drive visible; the motor still needs its controller and power.
reaction: Seeing the whole drive path described makes the guard more meaningful than a simple cover.
reason: Connect the battery and controller to power the machine; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the motor to run and send a visible wiggle along the tensioned cord, with the controller adjusting its speed.

effect: The powered peg sends a disturbance along the cord, and the far end reflects it; the chapter’s goal is complete.
reaction: The reflected wiggle is an interesting detail I hadn’t expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Powering the machine was the most worthwhile moment: the assembled drive finally made a visible travelling wiggle and showed it reflecting.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mounting the motor was a necessary but unremarkable setup step.

surprise.text: I expected a travelling wiggle, but not its reflection from the far end.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary. The sequence was understandable, although each decision offered only one combination.

continue.text: I would continue to see what the travelling and reflected wiggles might be used to show, though I’d hope for more meaningful choices.
